name: The Cheggins Cube 3x3
description: The Cheggins Cube 3x3 is an exact replica of the speedcube used by professional speedcuber Charlie Eggins! This puzzle was used by Charlie to set both 3x3 blindfolded World Records (11.67 single and 14.05 average) and win the event at the 2025 World Championships.
features: Original Packaging (Box, Protective Case, Accessory Box)
